nom: Rare Beauty Find Comfort Hydrating Under Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say the patches were gentle and non-irritating even overnight use, but one reports a rosacea flare-up after the cooling sensation.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being in their 50s-70s report visible de-puffing and a younger-looking effect, with no negative comments tied specifically to mature skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer in dry winter conditions describes the patches as especially hydrating for that skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoothed fine lines and a younger, brighter look, sometimes within minutes; one older reviewer calls it the best de-puffer she's tried, though these are subjective impressions rather than measured change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe a hydrating, moisturizing effect that leaves under-eyes feeling softer and refreshed; one reviewer, however, saw no real difference in hydration and another found the effect was cooling only, without added moisture.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports a flare-up triggered by the cooling sensation, which is the only redness-related account among the reviews.

aspects.libelle: Patches stay in place without sliding

extraits.texte: Solid patches, but nothing mind-blowing. They're nice and hydrating, feel cool and soothing under the eyes, and make your skin feel softer right after using them. Good for a quick pick-me-up or before going out. However, for me they didn't do much more than basic hydration ! no dramatic brightening or long-lasting improvement. Decent if you want something gentle and refreshing, but not a must-have.
They were not the best for my sensitive skin. They made my rosacea flare up after the cooling.
These are fabulous eye patches! I love the cooling and depuffing. Great on sensitive skin. Also you get 8 pairs!
These are very refreshing! I would definitely recommend these. I have very sensitive skin and was able to wear without irritation. Lovely product!

I am in love with these eye patches. I could not believe the difference when I used them before my makeup! My eye bags were all but gone and I have very bad hereditary bags/dark circles. I have never found a patch that did anything until these by Rare Beauty. I am a huge RB fan already, but I will be buying these in bulk!
I love these ! At 55 years old, the best de puffer I've ever tried.
LOVE LOVE LOVE these under eye patches so hydrating especially for this dry winter skin
